testCases.name: Functional Application Test
testCases.description: Verify the application has actual functionality beyond basic placeholder
steps: Verify multiple interactive elements exist (login form, buttons, inputs)
Check for proper navigation structure and routing
Verify application has real authentication features, not just 'Vite + React' placeholder text
Test that forms are interactive and functional
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application shows functional authentication features with interactive login/register forms, not a default Vite template
testCases.failureCondition: If page only shows 'Vite + React' placeholder without functional features, this test should FAIL

testCases.name: UI Components Test
testCases.description: Test that UI components are properly implemented and interactive
steps: Verify email input field is present and accepts input
Verify password input field is present and masks input
Verify name input field appears when switching to register mode
Check that submit button is clickable and responsive
Verify toggle between login and register modes works
Test form validation messages appear for invalid inputs
Check responsive design on different viewport sizes
testCases.expectedOutcome: All UI components are present, interactive, and properly styled with Tailwind CSS

testCases.name: Content Quality Test
testCases.description: Verify application has meaningful content and professional appearance
steps: Check page has substantial content beyond placeholder
Verify proper heading structure (h1, h2 tags)
Check for loading states and error messages
Ensure consistent branding and color scheme
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application demonstrates professional design with clear purpose and polished UI

testCases.name: User Registration - Valid Data
testCases.description: Test successful user registration with valid credentials
steps: Click 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link
Verify user data is displayed on dashboard
testCases.expectedOutcome: User is successfully registered, receives JWT token, and is redirected to protected dashboard

testCases.name: User Login - Valid Credentials
testCases.description: Test successful login with existing user credentials
steps: Ensure user is registered first (use auth-001 test user or create new)
Verify JWT token is received and stored
Verify user information is displayed correctly
testCases.expectedOutcome: User successfully logs in and accesses protected dashboard with valid session

testCases.name: User Login - Invalid Credentials
testCases.description: Test login failure with incorrect credentials
steps: Verify message states 'Invalid email or password'
Verify user remains on login page
testCases.expectedOutcome: Login fails with appropriate error message and user remains on login page

testCases.name: Registration - Password Too Short
testCases.description: Test password validation during registration
steps: Enter password with less than 6 characters: 'Pass1'
Verify message indicates minimum password length requirement
Verify user remains on registration page
testCases.expectedOutcome: Registration fails with error message about password length requirement (minimum 6 characters)

testCases.name: Registration - Duplicate Email
testCases.description: Test that duplicate email registration is prevented
steps: Attempt to register again with same email
Enter different name and password but same email
Verify message indicates email already exists
testCases.expectedOutcome: Registration fails with error message indicating email is already registered

testCases.name: User Logout
testCases.description: Test logout functionality and session clearing
steps: Verify JWT token is removed from storage
Verify user cannot access protected routes
Verify redirect back to login page
testCases.expectedOutcome: User is logged out, token cleared, and protected routes become inaccessible

testCases.name: Token Persistence After Refresh
testCases.description: Test that authentication persists after page refresh
steps: Verify user is logged in and dashboard is displayed
Refresh the page (F5 or browser refresh)
Verify dashboard still displays user information
Verify no redirect to login page occurs
testCases.expectedOutcome: User session persists after page refresh using Zustand persistence

testCases.name: API Health Check
testCases.description: Test backend health endpoint
steps: Verify response contains message 'Backend is running'
testCases.expectedOutcome: Health endpoint returns 200 status with confirmation backend is operational

testCases.name: API Register Endpoint Test
testCases.description: Test registration API endpoint directly
steps: Include JSON body with email, password, and name
Verify response contains user object without password
Verify user.created_at is a valid timestamp
testCases.expectedOutcome: API returns 201 status with user object and valid JWT token

testCases.name: API Login Endpoint Test
testCases.description: Test login API endpoint directly
steps: Include JSON body with email and password
Verify token is different from registration token (new expiry)
testCases.expectedOutcome: API returns 200 status with user object and valid JWT token

testCases.name: API Token Verification
testCases.description: Test token verification endpoint
steps: Login and obtain valid JWT token
Verify user data matches authenticated user
testCases.expectedOutcome: Verification endpoint confirms token validity and returns user data

testCases.name: API Get Current User
testCases.description: Test getting current authenticated user
steps: Login and obtain valid JWT token
Verify all user fields are present (id, email, name, created_at)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Endpoint returns current user information

testCases.name: API Update User Profile
testCases.description: Test profile update endpoint
steps: Login and obtain valid JWT token
Include JSON body with new name: 'Updated Name'
Verify response contains updated user object
Send GET request to /api/auth/me to confirm persistence
testCases.expectedOutcome: Profile is successfully updated and changes persist

testCases.name: API Protected Endpoint Access
testCases.description: Test protected endpoint with valid authentication
steps: Login and obtain valid JWT token
testCases.expectedOutcome: Protected endpoint accessible with valid token

testCases.name: Protected Route Without Token
testCases.description: Verify protected routes reject requests without authentication
steps: Send GET request to /api/auth/verify without Authorization header
Verify error message indicates token is required
testCases.expectedOutcome: All protected endpoints return 401 Unauthorized without token

testCases.name: Protected Route With Invalid Token
testCases.description: Verify protected routes reject invalid tokens
steps: Include Authorization header with invalid token: 'Bearer invalid_token_123'
Verify error message indicates invalid or expired token
Test with expired token (if possible to generate)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Protected endpoints return 403 Forbidden with invalid token

testCases.name: Password Security - Hashing
testCases.description: Verify passwords are properly hashed and not stored in plaintext
steps: Register a new user with password 'TestPassword123'
Verify password is NOT returned in response
Login with same credentials to confirm password works
Note: Direct database verification would require DB access to confirm bcrypt hashing
testCases.expectedOutcome: Passwords are never exposed in API responses and hashing is properly implemented

testCases.name: Email Case Insensitivity
testCases.description: Verify email addresses are case-insensitive
steps: Confirm same user account is accessed
testCases.expectedOutcome: Email authentication is case-insensitive (emails stored as lowercase)

testCases.name: CORS Configuration
testCases.description: Verify CORS is properly configured
steps: Verify credentials are allowed if needed
testCases.expectedOutcome: CORS is configured to allow frontend access while maintaining security

testCases.name: Protected Route Redirection
testCases.description: Test that unauthenticated users are redirected from protected routes
testCases.expectedOutcome: Unauthenticated users cannot access /dashboard and are redirected to login

testCases.name: Authenticated User Login Access
testCases.description: Test behavior when authenticated user visits login page
steps: Verify current behavior (stay on login or redirect to dashboard)
Note: This tests the expected UX pattern
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application handles authenticated user navigation appropriately

testCases.name: Catch-All Route Behavior
testCases.description: Test catch-all route redirects to appropriate page
steps: Check if redirected to /dashboard or /login based on auth status
testCases.expectedOutcome: Non-existent routes redirect to dashboard (then to login if not authenticated)

testCases.name: Loading States Display
testCases.description: Test loading indicators during async operations
steps: Verify loading spinner appears on submit button
Verify button text changes to 'Signing in...'
Verify button is disabled during loading
Verify page-level loading spinner on initial auth check
testCases.expectedOutcome: Loading states provide clear feedback during authentication operations

testCases.name: Error Message Display
testCases.description: Test error message display for various error scenarios
steps: Verify error message appears in red banner
Test error display for short password
Test error display for duplicate email
Verify error message clears when toggling between login/register
Verify error message clears on successful submission
testCases.expectedOutcome: Error messages are clearly displayed and user-friendly

testCases.name: Login/Register Form Toggle
testCases.description: Test toggling between login and registration modes
steps: Click 'Don't have an account? Sign up'
Verify form changes to registration mode
Verify button text changes to 'Create account'
Click 'Already have an account? Sign in'
Verify form returns to login mode
Verify form fields are cleared on toggle
testCases.expectedOutcome: Form seamlessly toggles between login and registration with appropriate field changes

testCases.name: Password Field Masking
testCases.description: Test password input field security
steps: Verify characters are masked (displayed as dots/asterisks)
Verify actual password is not visible
testCases.expectedOutcome: Password input is properly masked for security

testCases.name: Responsive Design Test
testCases.description: Test UI responsiveness across different screen sizes
steps: Verify layout is appropriate for large screens
Check form inputs are appropriately sized
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application is fully responsive and usable on all device sizes

testCases.name: Dashboard User Info Display
testCases.description: Test dashboard displays user information correctly
steps: Login as user with name 'John Doe' and email 'john@example.com'
Verify welcome message: 'Welcome back, John Doe!'
Check information is in styled info box
Verify navigation bar shows user name or profile link
testCases.expectedOutcome: Dashboard correctly displays all user information with proper formatting

testCases.name: Token Validation Performance
testCases.description: Test token validation completes quickly
testCases.expectedOutcome: Token validation completes within acceptable time limits

testCases.name: Initial Page Load Performance
testCases.description: Test initial application load time
steps: Measure time until page is interactive
Verify time to first contentful paint
Check JavaScript bundle size is reasonable
Verify images and assets load efficiently
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application loads within 3 seconds on standard connection

testCases.name: User Data Integrity
testCases.description: Test data consistency across operations
steps: Register user with specific name and email
Verify registration response contains correct data
Verify login response contains same user ID
testCases.expectedOutcome: User data remains consistent across all operations

testCases.name: Timestamp Accuracy
testCases.description: Test created_at timestamp is accurate
steps: Verify timestamp is within 5 seconds of current time
Verify timestamp format is ISO 8601 or valid date string
testCases.expectedOutcome: Timestamps are accurate and properly formatted

testCases.name: Empty Field Validation
testCases.description: Test form validation for empty required fields
steps: Click submit without entering any data
Verify validation for all required fields
Test partial completion (email only, password only)
testCases.expectedOutcome: Form validation prevents submission of empty required fields

testCases.name: Special Characters in Input
testCases.description: Test handling of special characters in user inputs
steps: Register user with name containing special chars: "O'Neil"
Register user with email containing plus: "test+tag@example.com"
Test password with various special characters
Verify all special characters are handled correctly
testCases.expectedOutcome: Application correctly handles special characters in all input fields

tools: Playwright or Cypress for E2E testing
Vitest for component and unit testing
automationRecommendations.cicd: Run phase1_critical tests on every commit, full suite on PR merge
